protocol.design: randomized complete block, paired by block
protocol.processIsolation: Fresh Playwright incognito context and page per artifact; Chromium restarts after every balanced 2n block cycle.
protocol.coldDefinition: Unique-source parse/eval/mount in a fresh Chromium context with code cache defeated by a block-specific source URL.
protocol.warmDefinition: 500 app or 500 LSX untimed browser interactions precede a long measured loop.
protocol.cpuClock: Chromium CDP Performance TaskDuration with threadTicks (main-thread CPU), paired with in-page performance.now wall time.
protocol.ramDefinition: Chromium Runtime.getHeapUsage, Oilpan/embedder heap, DOM/listener counters, and summed Chromium-process RSS after four CDP forced GCs.
protocol.confidence: Paired 95% percentile bootstrap confidence intervals and paired sign-flip permutation p-values.

environment: Playwright 1.62.1, Chromium 151.0.7922.34; 4000 app and 4000 LSX measured browser interactions
